paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend. The kingdom of this world belongs to the Lord, and He hasn't let go of it for one second. The seventh trumpet sounds and loud voices call out in heaven: "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever." (Revelation 11:15) That's the ending, baker, and it's already settled!

Now look at what comes before it. The two witnesses finish their testimony, the beast overpowers them, and the world celebrates (Revelation 11:7, 10). It looks like the bad guys got the last word. But God's breath of life enters the witnesses, they stand on their feet, and they hear "Come up here." (Revelation 11:11-12) I think that's for every baker who feels outnumbered, because the world gets a loud moment, and God gets the last word.

So what do you do with that? You stay faithful, even when it costs you and nobody's cheering. The elders say the time has come to "reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great." (Revelation 11:18) Small AND great, friend, so nobody who fears Him gets skipped. And that's why I keep my ovens ready, because the King is coming and I want the cookies done right!
